verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software platform with a programmatic API. Issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any developer API or credential system: its legaltech mentions describe internal AI tools and a startup incubator.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
